recycled-definition: "<meta charset> Required Declare UTF-8 as the document character encoding in the first 1024 bytes of the HTML, so browsers parse text correctly before they hit any non-ASCII content."

recycled-definition: "<title> element Required Every HTML document must have exactly one non-empty <title> element inside <head>. It is used by browsers, search engines, screen readers, social previews, and AI agents."

recycled-definition: "robots.txt Recommended A plain-text file at the site root that tells crawlers which paths they may or may not fetch. Standardised in RFC 9309 and supported by every major search engine."
